lines.zh: 布套底下是骨架，走起来会响
lines.en: Under the suit is an endoskeleton; it rattles as I walk.
I walk slowly, and you can't get away.

lines.zh: 黄漆剥了，露出里面的铁
lines.en: The yellow paint peeled, showing iron underneath.
Each step is closer than the last.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，走起来更歪
lines.en: My head sits crooked, and it tilts more as I walk.

lines.zh: 走廊太窄，我肩膀蹭着墙
lines.en: The hall is narrow; my shoulders scrape the walls.

lines.zh: 你听见的脚步声，是我的
lines.en: The footsteps you hear are mine.
This place used to have lights on.
I don't chase; I'm just faster than you.
The door's open, which is convenient.
A bell rang once, and it was me.

lines.zh: 这片地板的每块响木，我都踩过
lines.en: I've stepped on every creaking board here.

lines.zh: 我就这样坐着，像一具旧玩偶
lines.en: I sit like an old doll.

lines.zh: 身上的布套破了好几处
lines.en: The suit is torn in several places.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，谁都以为我坏了
lines.en: When I'm still, everyone thinks I'm broken.
The tube light overhead is buzzing.
This face has always been smiling.

lines.zh: 舞台的幕布垂着，没动过。
lines.en: The stage curtain hangs untouched.
The bones inside clicked once.
This place closed years ago.
I remember every night shift.
You've seen me.
Stop, don't take another step.
You should know this face.
Your flashlight is shaking.
You thought I was a prop.

lines.zh: 我在你面前站了很久了
lines.en: I've stood in front of you a long while.
You back to the door, and it's locked.

lines.zh: 我身上有股旧布的味道
lines.en: I smell of old cloth.
The smile is welded on.
No one's coming to collect you tonight.
The suit tore and some stuffing fell out.
The iron inside shifted.
I don't cry out; I can't.
That dented one spot.
My smile hasn't changed.
You hit my head.
I take a step back, joints grinding.
More yellow paint flaked off.

lines.zh: 这点伤，比不上我这些年
lines.en: This is nothing next to these years.

lines.zh: 你再打，我就抓住你的手
lines.en: Hit again and I'll take your hand.
I don't eat.

lines.zh: 你手里那块披萨，早凉了
lines.en: That pizza in your hand went cold long ago.
Put that thing away.
All I want is for you to stand there.
Food does nothing for me.
Stop waving it about.
I can't smell a thing.
That smell only irritates me.
You think that will hold me up.
Put it on the table, then back away.
Hit me and you're shoved back.
This body is far heavier than yours.
Don't brush against my suit.
Three steps back, and you're still here.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀撞到墙，墙裂了
lines.en: My shoulder hit the wall and it cracked.

lines.zh: 我的脚底压住了你的鞋尖。
lines.en: My foot pins the tip of your shoe.
I didn't even sway.
Don't squeeze past me.
You hit me like hitting iron.
Move, I'm coming through.

lines.zh: 里面那副骨架，没有那种用
lines.en: The frame inside has no such use.
There are others, also in this place.
We stand side by side and say nothing.
The place closed and that's that.
You're looking for someone else.

lines.zh: 空壳和空壳，没什么可谈
lines.en: Two empty shells have nothing to discuss.
My face stays smiling.
Neither of us needs to breathe. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，手指是硬的
lines.en: I can't pick it up; my fingers are stiff.
I see something on the floor.
This badge belonged to a staff member.
Bending is hard; my joints grind.
This is yours.
I pinch it, not very steadily.
What fell here is from that night.
I set it on the table.
There's blood on the floor, and it isn't mine.
These old things, I don't need them.
You're at the end of the corridor.
I turn my head toward you.
So late, and still a guest.
You carry a flashlight's beam.
I hear you holding your breath.
That door won't open for you.
I've watched you through the cameras.
I've memorized your position.
You're alone now.

lines.zh: 你站在我原来站的地方
lines.en: You're standing where I used to stand.

lines.zh: 这一间屋子，进来就出不去
lines.en: This room doesn't let people out.
You took the wrong door.
I'm coming your way.
You turned the light off; good.

lines.zh: 最后一个人，我留到最后
lines.en: The last one, I save for last.
You retreat, and I follow.
Walls don't stop me.
The breathing behind the door is yours.
You're counting seconds; so am I.

lines.zh: 我把头歪向一边，看得更清楚
lines.en: I tilt my head to see better.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也只是这栋楼里
lines.en: Run as fast as you like; you're still in this building.
That flashlight is dying.
You're at the door, and the door groans.
You shouldn't have looked back.
This face is getting closer.
The corridor light went out.
There's no way ahead.
I shake the dust off my suit.
One more step back and you're against the wall.

lines.zh: 那扇门后面，我站过很多次
lines.en: I've stood behind that door many times.

lines.zh: 你的手电照到了我的脚
lines.en: Your beam found my feet.
Now it's my turn to look at you.
A hand reaches out and closes.
That one keeps you down.

lines.zh: 我的力气大得不像玩偶
lines.en: My strength is not doll-like.
The iron inside the suit rams home.
You're thrown into the door.

lines.zh: 我这一下，你不用再站起来
lines.en: After this one you won't need to stand again
My knuckles are hard as nails.
Blood spatters on this smiling face.
You can still stand; good.
One more and I'll have you.

lines.zh: 我的动作不快，可你躲不开
lines.en: I'm not fast, but you can't dodge.
The shield you raised cracked.
My palm presses on your chest.
The bone sounds louder than the suit.

lines.zh: 那一晚，我也这样抓过人
lines.en: I grabbed someone like this that night too.
You back away, and I hold still.
Once I grab, I don't let go.

lines.zh: 你在我身上打了一拳，没用
lines.en: You punched me; it did nothing.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着看你怎么倒
lines.en: My head tilts as I watch you fall.
This one will make you remember me.

lines.zh: 门开了一道缝，我站在里面
lines.en: The door opened a crack and I stood inside.
This suit of mine is old.

lines.zh: 从后台走出来，灰尘飞起来
lines.en: I walk out from backstage and dust rises.

lines.zh: 灯管闪了一下，我就到了
lines.en: The tube light flickered and I arrived.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋打开，我站在走廊
lines.en: The egg opened and I stood in the corridor.
The crate backstage is empty.
This is my diner; you're late.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，关节响了一下
lines.en: I raise a hand and a joint pops.
The stage lights come on.
I've waited a long time for this day.
The door shut behind me.
Tonight there are people, at least.

lines.zh: 火烧到布套，里面的铁还热
lines.en: Fire caught the suit; the iron inside is still hot.
I fell without changing posture.

lines.zh: 水灌进布套，我沉得很快
lines.en: Water fills the suit and I sink fast.

lines.zh: 炸掉了我半边脸，笑还在
lines.en: Half my face is gone; the smile remains.
The arrow sank into the padding.

lines.zh: 法术打在我身上，亮了一下
lines.en: The spell flashed on me once.
I don't starve, only age.

lines.zh: 雷打穿我，里面的线全乱了
lines.en: Lightning went through and scrambled my wiring.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地板，我照样走
lines.en: No floor in the void, and I still walk.
